messages:
maria: Hey all — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/30567 is ready for review. It's a canary rollout that introduces a KV-prefetch path and a tiny change to the config schema (orch.eviction.enable -> orch.eviction.kv_prefetch). Need runtime perf sign-off, infra for the schema migration, and security for KMS scope changes. Targeting merge window TOMORROW 10:00 PT. Who can own each approval?

kevin: I can take runtime. I'll run the perf job against canary traffic and sanity the p99 numbers. ETA 4h.

anya: I can do security — quick question: are we adding any new KMS roles or key access patterns? If so, need the exact policy diff.

rahul: infra here. Schema change looks straightforward but will need a migration plan and a rollout flag so older agents aren't broken. Can you add a migration section to the PR describing the backwards-compatible path?

maria: Thanks — will add migration steps now and attach the policy diff. planning to add a rollout flag and default it off for one day then flip.

maria: policy snippet: ```
- allow: kms:Decrypt
- resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
(not the final ARN, placeholder for now)

anya: that looks fine in principle. I'll need the final ARN and a brief justification line. Also note: for canary we should scope the key to the canary role principal only. :lock: 

kevin: perf quick update — ran 20k short requests with kv-prefetch enabled on canary AMI. median latency +3ms, p95 +8ms, p99 unchanged. CPU util up ~4%. Looks acceptable but will rerun with mixed-length sequences.

kevin: attaching perf log: ```
median: 12ms
p95: 32ms
p99: 75ms
cpu: 64% -> 68%
```

rahul: migration plan looks OK after adding a feature flag. We'll also want a config validator in startup to ignore the unknown key if older agent pops. Can you add a unit test for config loader?

maria: Will add unit tests and the validator patch. Pushing updates in ~30m.

sre-oncall: FYI — canary window OK from SRE side at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Recommend a 10-min pause after first batch for quick rollbacks. :thumbsup:

maria: Great. Plan summary: kevin runtime sign-off, anya security pending final ARN & justification, rahul infra will validate migration+validator, SRE approved canary window. I'll follow up with PR update and ping again when done. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
